Done. `app/BlogHeader.tsx` now loads both fonts via `next/font/google` and applies them, with all font logic contained in the component: - `Playfair_Display` is applied to the `

` ("My Personal Blog") - `Roboto` is applied to the `

` subtitle ("Thoughts, ideas, and musings") Both loaders are declared at module scope (required by `next/font`, which processes them at build time) with `subsets: ['latin']` and `display: 'swap'`. I checked the bundled font metadata for this Next.js version and both fonts ship as variable fonts, so no explicit `weight` option is needed. Fonts are self-hosted by Next.js, so the browser makes no requests to Google at runtime. Type-checking passes (`tsc --noEmit` exits cleanly). I didn't run a full `next build` because the font loader fetches the font files from Google Fonts at build time, which needs network access; if your environment blocks that, the build will fail with a fetch error unrelated to the code itself.
